comment: M0 §5.2. Pinned in git: every record and every registry entry carries the commit SHA of this file. Targets are release-manifest ROLES, resolved to addresses from the watcher config.

SLASH.reason: BLS operator slash executed (impossible through DVTValidator in 5.5.0: empty evidence allowlist; so this came by the owner route)

REPUTATION.reason: BLS reputation batch (5.5.0 does no reputation scoring)

QUEUE.reason: operator frozen by a guardian quorum (queueSlashWithConsensus)

expected.reason: BLS price update: threshold is caller-chosen (>= minThreshold); SP caps each update but not a chain of updates

unexpected.reason: generic BLS call outside the expected target/selector set

UNRECOVERED.reason: BLS-executed action whose message could not be authenticated from the transaction

ownerRoute.label: owner/guardian route: not BLS, no on-chain signer verification
